Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 2026

This policy explains what personal data this website collects, why, and what your rights are. Sample document — have it reviewed by a qualified professional before publishing.

Data controller

The controller of data collected through this website is Tamara Ferreira, reachable at the email address listed on the contact page.

Data collected

Contact form: name, email, subject and message content.

Newsletter: name and email address.

This website uses no advertising cookies and no behavioural tracking.

Purpose and legal basis

Contact form data is used solely to answer the enquiry sent. Newsletter data is used solely to send the newsletter. In both cases the legal basis is the explicit consent given at the point of submission.

Retention

Contact messages are kept for as long as needed to follow up on the matter. Newsletter subscription data is kept until the subscription is cancelled.

Your rights

You may request access to, correction of, deletion of or restriction of the processing of your data at any time, object to processing, and exercise your right to data portability. Just send a request to the email address on the contact page.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese data protection authority (CNPD).
